text.brief: On May 14, 1995, the Dalai Lama named six-year-old Gedhun Choekyi Nyima the eleventh Panchen Lama.
text.record: Security forces took the boy and his parents into custody within days. The Party jailed Chadrel Rinpoche, the abbot who led the search. In November it staged a lottery with a golden urn and installed its own candidate, Gyaincain Norbu ([CECC analysis: Government policy on Tibetan reincarnation leads to expulsions, detentions](https://www.cecc.gov/publications/commission-analysis/government-policy-on-tibetan-reincarnation-leads-to-expulsions)). Gedhun has not appeared in public since 1995 ([State Department 2023 Report on International Religious Freedom: Tibet](https://2021-2025.state.gov/reports/2023-report-on-international-religious-freedom/china/tibet/); [USCIRF: Gedhun Choekyi Nyima, freedom of religion or belief victims database](https://www.uscirf.gov/religious-prisoners-conscience/forb-victims-database/gedhun-choekyi-nyima)). In 2020 Congress passed the Tibetan Policy and Support Act, which states that the choice of the next Dalai Lama belongs to Tibetan Buddhists alone ([CECC: Chairs welcome passage of the Tibetan Policy and Support Act (2020)](https://www.cecc.gov/media-center/press-releases/chairs-welcome-passage-of-the-tibetan-policy-and-support-act); [State Department 2020 Report on International Religious Freedom: Tibet](https://www.state.gov/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/240282-TIBET-2020-INTERNATIONAL-RELIGIOUS-FREEDOM-REPORT.pdf)).
text.reading: The Party took a child to control a succession decades away, so Time became the weapon. It borrowed a Qing court urn to dress a political choice as a religious rite, which is Stratagem 14.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. The defender voiced concern for twenty-five years before it wrote the principle of religious succession into law.
text.fix: Name the officials who hold a disappeared person and apply the sanctions the law already allows, year after year.
